 KEYS

  Dashboard (cards and compact table)
    ← → / ↑ ↓  move the agent selection
    enter/tab  detail of the selected agent
    1 2 3 4    switch view (Dashboard, History, Report, Timeline)
    h / i      open History or Report
    l          full log of the last run
    d          actual diff of the last run
    c / w      open its dir in VS Code / in a new terminal
    t          toggle between cards and compact table
    m          show or hide mascots
    p          pet the selected agent's mascot
    r          ask codex, agy, claude and opencode for their quota now (cursor has none)
    ?          open this help
    q          quit

  Agent detail
    ← →        switch agent
    ↑ ↓ / j k  scroll the content
    PgUp/PgDn  page down or up
    g/G / Home go to the top or bottom
    l          full log of the last run
    d          actual diff of the last run
    esc/tab    back to the dashboard (or enter)

  History
    ↑ ↓ / j k  move the run selection
    PgUp/PgDn  page down or up
    g/G / Home go to the first or last run
    enter/tab  detail of the selected run
    /          search text in task, model or dir
    f          filter by agent (all → claude → agy → codex → opencode → cursor)
    e          filter by result (failures, quota, done, running)
